newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical up after Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical up after Q1 earnings.

text.p: Shares in Dow Chemical Co rose 1-5/8 Thursday after the company reported flat first quarter earnings, but said it expects a strong quarter in the second period.

Dow reported first quarter earnings per share of $1.90, unchanged from a year ago. Revenues were $4.99 billion, up slightly from $4.98 billion. Selling prices fell two percent because of a negative currency impact of $100 million.

The company said portfolio restructuring, higher productivity and lower costs offset about $200 million of the more than $300 million Dow had total in higher feedstock costs and unfavorable currency impacts.
Dow said in a statement that lower feedstock costs, price stability in key products and ongoing productivity improvements will result in a strong second quarter for the company.
